content.text:
I didn't get both answers. After 8 years it shows about 69,000 ₪ in hand ("נשאר בידיים 68,853"), from 500 a month. For 4 years the calculator gave me nothing for self-employed people. It only says you pay tax if you take the money out before 6 years. I'm fairly sure about the 8 years and sure that 4 years didn't work. What decided it: the 4-year bar was just an empty dashed box. My takeaway is don't touch it before year 6.

**How it went:**
- **First screen:** I saw the heading and the line "after a set time you can take it out without tax". Then "אחרי 6 שנים" in the text, so 6 years stuck.
- **Scrolling down:** I skimmed the part saying self-employed can put in up to 20,566 ₪ a year. I skipped "חוקים וכללים" and the investment track buttons.
- **Calculator ("כמה כסף נשאר לכם, ומתי?"):** I switched it to "עצמאים". It had 500 ₪ a month and 7% already filled in. The task gave no amount, so I left those.
- **Year chart:** years 1–5 were empty dotted boxes. I tapped 4 and got the orange text "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים", plus one number, 25,725, over an empty dashed bar.
- **Where I got lost:** I almost took 25,725 as my 4-year amount. The label under it, "אותו כסף בחשבון…", was cut off by the round up-arrow button. Only at year 8 could I read the whole label: "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך". So it's the same money in some other account, not the fund.
- **Year 8:** reading from the right I hit 55,471 first. Then the bold "נשאר בידיים" 68,853, and further left "הפקדתם" 48,000. I didn't work out the coloured parts of the bars, just read the words under them.

**Words I didn't get:** "הכנסה חייבת", "החזר המס הוסיף" (it says +9,581, and I don't know where that comes from), "ניירות ערך", "מסלול מדד". There was also an "המס לקח" bar showing 0, which I don't understand.

**What I'd change:**
- Give self-employed people some number for early withdrawal, even a rough one. That's half of what I came to check.
- Don't put a lone number over an empty box. It looks like the answer.
- Move that floating up-arrow button so it doesn't cover the labels.
